descriptions.setup: Define detector channels and PIE time windows once for all imaging tools.
descriptions.browser: Browse TTTR image files and explore intensity maps.
descriptions.drift: Optional pre-processing: measure and remove inter-frame sample drift. Belongs before the numbered steps — every per-pixel map below is built from frames that must already be aligned. Photon streams are corrected photon by photon, so the steps below still see real photons.
descriptions.frc: How fine a detail this acquisition actually resolves, by Fourier ring correlation between two independent halves of it. Sits after Drift because drift blurs the image and so lowers the measured resolution — measure it on frames that are already aligned.
descriptions.flow: Map the velocity field: one arrow per tile, over the image. Sits beside Tracking because both measure motion rather than building a per-pixel map -- and after Drift for the same reason Tracking is, since a drifting stage is indistinguishable from a sample flowing the other way. Tracking follows individual particles; this reads a velocity from the correlations of everything at once, so it works where the labels are too dense to resolve as spots.
descriptions.tracking: Follow individual particles through the frames and fit their diffusion coefficient. Sits after Drift because a drifting sample looks exactly like directed motion, and outside the numbered steps because it measures motion rather than building a per-pixel map.
descriptions.pixel_intensity: Per-pixel intensity map; creates the standard imaging HDF5 (with source back-reference).
descriptions.pixel_nb: Per-pixel Number (N) and Brightness (B); adds fields to the imaging HDF5.
descriptions.pixel_micro_time: Per-pixel mean micro-time (arrival time, ns) per detector window; adds fields to the imaging HDF5.
descriptions.calibration: Optional: per-detector IRF file + background (kHz); transferred to Phasor and MLE. Skippable.
descriptions.pixel_phasor: Per-pixel phasor (g, s) maps and phasor plot; adds fields to the imaging HDF5.
descriptions.pixel_mle: Pixel-wise MLE lifetime analysis; adds fields to the imaging HDF5.
descriptions.clsm_draw: Interactive CLSM pixel selection, ROI drawing and decay extraction; opens imaging HDF5 (via source back-reference).
descriptions.spot_finder: Find the regions — molecules, beads, objects — and write them, with their pixels, into each measurement's container.
descriptions.molecule_mle: Lifetime MLE per region, on the regions the Spot Finder found.
descriptions.psf: 3D Gaussian PSF fitting and bead detection.
